claims.evidence: Photos 0-3 show wooden pallets; Photo 2 shows EPAL side stamps, a European mark consistent with foreign origin.

risks.risk: Total number of pallets for sale is unknown
risks.proof: Wide photo or video showing the full stack/lot with a countable number, or the seller's stated quantity
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single pallet only

risks.proof: Tape-measure shot of pallet length, width, and height
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-standard or unknown size

risks.risk: Wood treatment (heat-treated vs chemically treated) is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up of the IPPC/EPAL stamp showing the treatment code
risks.if_unproven: priced as chemically treated or untreated with restricted use

risks.risk: Broken boards, loose nails, or rot may be present
risks.proof: Close-up panning clip of all pallet faces, stringers, and blocks
risks.if_unproven: priced as damaged or unsound requiring repair or scrap

risks.risk: Unclear whether sale is per pallet or for the whole stack
risks.proof: Seller confirmation in writing or photo of the full lot with quantity

risks.risk: Seller's exact location in Abuja and delivery/pickup terms are unknown
risks.proof: Map pin or verifiable address plus a screenshot of delivery cost or pickup-only terms
risks.if_unproven: priced as buyer pickup from an unknown location with no delivery

proof_requests: Total number of pallets for sale
Exact dimensions (length x width x height)
Close-up of the treatment stamp (HT or MB)
Close-up photos of all pallet sides for damage, loose nails, or rot
Whether sale is per pallet or for the whole stack
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as used wooden EPAL pallets, so a worst-case price is possible; missing quantity, condition, treatment, and terms only set the starting discount.
